code_or_query:
import numpy as np
# battery 24V 20Ah = 480 Wh; loads: drive 4x50W=200W, ladder 150W, compute+cams 30W
V=24.0; Ah=20.0
E_wh=V*Ah
# 25 min run: dig 40% (drive+ladder+compute), transit 40% (drive+compute), dump/idle 20% (compute+actuator burst)
P_dig=200+150+30
P_transit=200+30
P_dump=30+100
T_h=25/60
E_use= T_h*(0.4*P_dig+0.4*P_transit+0.2*P_dump)
print(f"pack {E_wh:.0f} Wh use {E_use:.0f} Wh margin {E_wh/E_use:.2f}x")
# motor heating: 150W in, 70% eff -> 45W heat, thermal mass 1.5kg steel+Cu ~500 J/kgK
Pheat=150*0.3
Cth=1.5*500
for t in [60,150,300]:
    print(f"t={t}s dT={Pheat*t/Cth:.1f} K")
